newsitem.title: USA: Case Corp Q3 net falls.
newsitem.headline: Case Corp Q3 net falls.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: 1996 Q3 earnings per share exclude cumulative effect of changes in accounting principles and extraordinary items, which reduced earnings by $0.14 a share, to $0.66.
Net earnings available to common primary shares, after preferred stock dividends, totalled $49 million vs $86 million.
Fully diluted Q3 earnings per common share after changes in accounting and extraordinary items were $0.66 vs $1.16.
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Nine months earnings per share exclude cumulative effect of changes in accounting and extraordinary items, which reduced earnings by $0.45 a share vs $0.12.
Net earnings available to common primary shares, after preferred stock dividends, were $209 million vs $254 million.
Fully diluted earnings per common share after changes in accounting and extraordinary items for the nine months were $2.77 vs $3.43.
